name: Eyes of Minute Seeing
summary: Lenses that let you see tiny details within 1 foot.

stats.effect: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, your vision improves significantly out to a range of 1 foot, granting you {ref:glossary/darkvision} within that range and {ref:glossary/advantage} on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to examine something within that range.
